regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 56". Sugar Bowl and Palisades follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Kirkwood: 62 to 91 inches Wednesday through Sunday night. Winter Storm Warning at Kirkwood from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 41", 21" of it Wednesday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 62 to 86 inches Wednesday through Sunday night. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbasin is forecast for about 12", 10" of it Friday. Powder Mountain and Snowbird follow. The NWS is calling for more at Snowbasin: 10 to 20 inches Thursday through Friday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 9", 5" of it Friday. Sun Valley and Jackson Hole follow. The NWS is calling for more at Grand Targhee: 7 to 20 inches Wednesday through Monday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 9", 6" of it Monday. Steamboat and Crested Butte follow. The NWS is calling for more at Steamboat: 3 to 9 inches Thursday night through Monday night.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 8", 5" of it Friday. Taos follows. The NWS is calling for more at Wolf Creek: 3 to 12 inches Thursday night through Monday.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
